decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent.

changes.quote: Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in April indicates that the economic recovery is continuing at a moderate pace, though somewhat more slowly than the Committee had expected.
changes.explanation: The Fed acknowledged that the economic recovery is happening more slowly than previously anticipated.

changes.quote: Also, recent labor market indicators have been weaker than anticipated.
changes.explanation: Job market data came in softer than the Fed expected.

changes.quote: The slower pace of the recovery reflects in part factors that are likely to be temporary, including the damping effect of higher food and energy prices on consumer purchasing power and spending as well as supply chain disruptions associated with the tragic events in Japan.
changes.explanation: The Fed attributes part of the slowdown to temporary issues like high commodity prices and supply chain problems from Japan.

changes.quote: Inflation has picked up in recent months, mainly reflecting higher prices for some commodities and imported goods, as well as the recent supply chain disruptions.
changes.explanation: Recent inflation increased due to specific commodity and supply chain pressures.

changes.quote: The Committee will complete its purchases of $600 billion of longer-term Treasury securities by the end of this month and will maintain its existing policy of reinvesting principal payments from its securities holdings.
changes.explanation: The Fed confirmed it is finishing its $600 billion bond-buying program as planned.

tone_quotes.quote: Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in April indicates that the economic recovery is continuing at a moderate pace, though somewhat more slowly than the Committee had expected.
Also, recent labor market indicators have been weaker than anticipated.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 13.44% APR costs about $56.00 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 3.01% and moved +2 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 4.49% would rise by about $3.57 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 9%, and employers added an average of 215k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 3.5% over the past year (May 2011); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.5%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a -0.9% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -1 bp on the day.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.06% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Fed intends to maintain low interest rates for an extended period while it wraps up its current asset purchase program.

citations.detail: To promote the ongoing economic recovery and to help ensure that inflation, over time, is at levels consistent with its mandate, the Committee decided today to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent.
